purpose: Bridge the existing source-blind direct numerical weight-programming line from 6-bit causal rules toward cumulative compositional knowledge. This is not a language model or unrestricted intelligence.
hypothesis: Directly edited executable numerical adjacency weights can acquire previously unknown entities/relations from grounded edge observations, infer unshown exact two-hop consequences by numerical composition, accommodate newly introduced entities, selectively replace contradictory information, and cold-restore prior unaffected knowledge without gradients or stored query labels.

worlds.source: SHA256 seeded disjoint synthetic directed relation paths over invented nonword entity names. Distinct relation-specific orders and independently salted IDs. No model receives withheld query truths.
worlds.acquisition: Stage A: observe each of two relation paths' eleven directed edges. Stage B: observe third relation path over sixteen entities; extend first path to four new entities; apply two explicit retractions and replacements to the second relation path. Observations are the only valid positive writer updates.
worlds.scoring: Evaluator-only all 16x16x3 ordered entity/relation pairs for exact length-one and length-two consequences, plus unknown-label abstain audits. Neither learner nor controls may inspect evaluator queries/labels before all predictions freeze.

candidate.cognitive_input: Grounded whole-string UTF-8 entity and relation identifiers supplied by a separate perception layer, not language tokens, sentence parsing, or an autoregressive model.
candidate.write: Numerical 0/1 edge weights in dynamically grown relation-indexed square matrices. Write only upon observed fact; retraction zeros exactly the observed edge. Identity indices are public, determined from seen names only.
candidate.cold_inference: Length-one as matrix cell, length-two as full numeric matrix product (sum of weight products); no ledger, source graph, query table, or gradient updates.
candidate.known_limitation: Two-hop composition is engineered; this is NOT learned unrestricted reasoning, world knowledge, language understanding, or an efficiency improvement over a graph.

matched_controls: Independent symbolic set-of-directed-edges with graph traversal on precisely the same observations, including retractions; exact parity required.
Literal observed one-hop fact lookup without relational composition; expected to fail unseen two-hop except coincidental direct-edge overlap.
A zeroed numerical matrix negative control; must eliminate learned positive predictions.

outcomes.development_classification: DEV_SUBSTRATE_FEASIBLE only if all engineering and frozen metrics hold. This never implies SCIENTIFIC_PASS or superiority to equal-expressivity symbolic graph.
outcomes.negative_classification: DEV_SUBSTRATE_NEGATIVE if any metric fails; do not modify criteria or world generation to recover a positive.

sequence: Implement new standalone source/writer/independent control/tests, preserving all WSP80-WSP86 sources and negatives
Local structural fixture tests can use public fixture seeds outside reserved DEV range
Mandatory exact SHA focused tests, inherited final full regression on Windows and Ubuntu and G29 atlas before frozen DEV cohort use
One deterministic first-use DEV experiment only after qualification and owner source rules; preserve any negative

Follow up with raw language grounding, source-backed real-world fact acquisition, unseen predicates, conflicting reports, and genuine cross-domain transfer. These are separate preregistered experiments, not assertions of current capability.
interpretation: A viable numerical knowledge store is a necessary but profoundly insufficient ingredient for Claude/GPT-class performance. Exact graph ties demonstrate representation feasibility, not general intelligence.
